thesis: The podcast argues that while agentic coding has achieved product-market fit, the broader market faces a supply crunch and pricing imbalance that prevents foundation models from being affordable commodities. Consequently, fundamental questions regarding which companies will win, how much value they can capture up the stack, and how consumers will use the technology daily remain unanswered.
